records.symptom: Pressing force too low; parts not formed deep enough
records.action: Reset the pressure switch to the specified value. Checked the depth with a trial stroke

records.symptom: Pressure will not build. The motor runs but the pump side makes noise
records.cause: Worn rubber spider in the coupling between pump and motor
records.action: Replaced the rubber spider. Checked the alignment and ran a trial

records.symptom: The hydraulic oil is white and cloudy
records.cause: Cooling water entering through an internal leak in the oil cooler
records.action: Replaced the oil cooler and all the hydraulic oil. Cleaned the tank

records.cause: Debris in the throttle of the flow control valve
records.action: Took the flow control valve apart, cleaned it and readjusted the speed

records.symptom: Pressure will not build. The pump is quiet and the gauge is near zero
records.cause: Broken coil in the unloading solenoid valve
records.action: Measured the coil resistance with a tester and found it open. Replaced the coil

records.symptom: The emergency stop cannot be reset
records.cause: Poor contact in the emergency stop button
records.action: Replaced the button unit and checked the emergency stop circuit
